description: Stage and defense presentations. The characteristic failures are a caption that names a category instead of the content, a visual reference with nothing to anchor it, a plan presented as an achievement, and filler where a claim belongs.

rules.message: Name the quantity, group, and condition shown instead of the kind of object.
Give the number of the figure or slide being referred to.

rules.pattern: (?i)(?<![а-яё])(?:ожидается, что|должно улучшить|планируется получить|позволит значительно|в перспективе достигн\w+|будет достигнут\w*)(?![а-яё])
rules.message: Separate what was achieved from what is intended; a plan is not a result.

rules.pattern: (?i)(?<![а-яё])(?:немного о|несколько слов о|краткий обзор того|пару слов о|как известно)(?![а-яё])
rules.message: Replace the filler with the statement the slide is meant to carry.
Give the measured value with its unit and uncertainty instead of an approximation.
